```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

wells_raw <- read_csv("data-raw/groundwater/wells.csv", col_types = "cccd")   # x, y read as text on purpose
gw_raw <- read_csv("data-raw/groundwater/groundwater_benzene.csv", col_types = "cDcc")
tank_farm <- c(482900, 5700700)        # the old tank farm, UTM zone 32N (EPSG:32632)
supply_well <- c(484700, 5700750)      # the town's drinking-water well, PW-1
limit_map <- 10                        # ug/L, the regulator's mapping threshold
limit_dw <- 1                          # ug/L, the drinking-water standard
```

```{r}
#| label: look
```

## 2. Cleaning

<!-- Record every decision here, and in the cleaning log at the end. -->

```{r}
#| label: clean-wells
wells <- wells_raw |> mutate(x = as.numeric(x), y = as.numeric(y))
wells |> filter(x < 1000)                                 # which well is in a different CRS?
# fix it: transform that well's point from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32632 with st_transform()
```

```{r}
#| label: clean-results
#| eval: false
gw <- gw_raw |>
  distinct() |>                                           # reasons: ...
  filter(result != "dry") |>
  mutate(censored = str_detect(result, "^<"),
         value = as.numeric(str_remove(result, "<")))
# the unit error: compare the medians by round and lab, then fix the round in mg/L
gw |> filter(!censored) |> group_by(date, lab) |> summarise(median = median(value), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(median)
# gw <- gw |> mutate(value = if_else(..., value * 1000, value))
gw <- gw |>
  left_join(wells, by = "well") |>
  mutate(log_value = log(if_else(censored, value / 2, value)),     # half the detection limit, for now
         years = as.numeric(date - as.Date("2019-01-01")) / 365.25)
```

## 3. Today's plume

<!-- The 2026 Q3 round: variogram, model, kriging, standard errors, cross-validation and the
     probability of exceeding 10 ug/L. -->

```{r}
#| label: today
#| eval: false
now <- gw |> filter(date == max(date))
v <- variogram(log_value ~ 1, ~x + y, data = now, cutoff = 1200, width = 100)
plot(v)
model <- fit.variogram(v, vgm(psill = ..., model = "Exp", range = ..., nugget = ...))
grid <- expand_grid(x = seq(482300, 484800, by = 25), y = seq(5700000, 5701400, by = 25))
k <- krige(log_value ~ 1, ~x + y, now, newdata = grid, model = model)
# maps: exp(k$var1.pred), sqrt(k$var1.var), and P(exceed 10) = 1 - pnorm((log(10) - pred) / se)
cv <- krige.cv(log_value ~ 1, ~x + y, now, model = model)
c(rmse = sqrt(mean(cv$residual^2)), mean_sq_z = mean(cv$zscore^2))
```

## 4. Is the plume shrinking and moving?

<!-- Krige every round on the same grid, then the mass proxy, the area above 10 ug/L and the
     centroid, over time. A half-life with an interval; the centroid's speed and direction. -->

```{r}
#| label: trend
#| eval: false
rounds <- sort(unique(gw$date))
by_round <- map_dfr(rounds, function(d) {
  kk <- krige(log_value ~ 1, ~x + y, filter(gw, date == d), newdata = grid, model = model, debug.level = 0)
  conc <- exp(kk$var1.pred)
  tibble(date = d, mass = sum(conc), area10_ha = sum(kk$var1.pred > log(limit_map)) * 25^2 / 1e4,
         cx = sum(grid$x * conc) / sum(conc), cy = sum(grid$y * conc) / sum(conc))
})
fit_mass <- lm(log(mass) ~ as.numeric(date - as.Date("2019-01-01")), data = by_round)
# half-life in years: ...
```

## 5. The sentinel wells

<!-- MW-36 and MW-37: their results, their trend (with the censoring handled), and when they
     might reach 1 ug/L if the trend continues. What can't the data say yet? -->

```{r}
#| label: sentinels
#| eval: false
gw |> filter(well %in% c("MW-36", "MW-37")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, value, shape = censored)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~ well) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = limit_dw, linetype = "dashed")
```
